name: zclass_typelist_alloc_link
description: zClass_TypeList::AllocLink allocates or reuses a type-list link and updates live/peak counters.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?AllocLink@zClass_TypeList@@YAPAUzClass_TypeListLink@@XZ at 0x44e630 currently fails with 54 unmasked mismatches after masking 28 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 93 bytes, the VC object symbol is 80 bytes with 4 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, and the triage artifact is build/vc5-verify/zclass_typelist_alloc_link/verify/44e630_byte_triage.txt. The current source spells the free-list reuse path before the calloc fallback and names the next-link slot, matching the BN block order more closely, but VC5SP3 still emits a shared zero register and shorter immediate-store sequence. A bounded profile sweep across VC5SP3 /Ob0, /Ob1, /Ob2, /GX, /MD and VC5SP3 /Ob0, /Ob1 profiles was neutral at 54 mismatches; volatile lvalues for the zeroing stores were also neutral, so the cleaner non-volatile source shape was restored. Additional local probes were also neutral or worse: an early-calloc source shape and a next-before-nextSlot/referenced-member lvalue spelling stayed at 54 mismatches, VC5SP3 /Oy /Ob0 and VC5SP3 /Ob2 /GX stayed at 54, while local VC5SP3 /O1 and /O2 /Og- probes worsened to 61 and 127 mismatches respectively.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x44e630 increments the live link count, updates the peak count, reuses g_zClass_TypeList_FreeLinkHead when present, clears prev/next/pendingRemove on reused links, and falls back to calloc(1, 16).
The native smoke verifies free-list reuse, next-head unlinking, cleared link fields, live/peak counter updates, and free-list reinsertion through FreeLink.
